desk.headline: Revenue down 2% in real terms to P$2.70trn (US$1.78bn); EBITDA up 13% real; P$56.6bn net loss on impairments; no guidance

other.label: EBITDA
other.change: +13% real y/y; 36.1% margin (31.3% a year ago)

other.label: Net loss
other.change: after P$383.9bn impairment on assets to be sold

results: Figures are in pesos adjusted for inflation to September 2026 prices (annual inflation was 33.4%). Revenue fell 2% in real terms to P$2.70trn; in US dollars it rose 18% to $1.78bn.
Service revenue slipped about 2% in real terms, held back by heavy discounts at Telefónica Móviles Argentina (TMA); mobile service revenue grew 5%, while fixed telephony and data fell 22%.
Costs before depreciation fell 9% in real terms, so EBITDA rose 13% to P$974bn and the margin widened to 36.1% from 31.3%.
A P$384bn impairment, mainly on TMA-related assets due to be sold, pushed the quarter to a net loss of P$56.6bn; nine-month net income was P$863bn.
Net debt fell 9% to US$2.93bn, or 1.2x EBITDA; the board accepted Metrotel's US$450m offer for the assets to be divested, pending antitrust approval.

guidance.summary: Telecom Argentina gave no financial guidance with these results.

watch: Antitrust approval of the asset sale to Metrotel and the US$450m payment.
Whether TMA's discounts fade and real service revenue returns to growth.
Peso inflation and exchange rate moves, which drive the real and US-dollar figures.

sources.title: Telecom Argentina 3Q26 and 9M26 results release — PR Newswire, 12 Nov 2026
